northStar: A convention circle catalogue printed on dark stock. Stamp-sized cells in a coded hall grid; the reader's own entries ringed in biro. Nothing on it may imply a ranking the API cannot support.

rules.searchTab: 4px solid #D1402F on the input's left edge

elevation.none: Printed matter carries no elevation. A cell is distinguished by being paper on stock; hover prints a 2px spot outline rather than raising anything.

motion.rule: Cells set into the hall the way a catalogue is pasted up. Transform only — never opacity — so a stalled paint, a failed script or a screenshot mid-stagger all show the full hall. Disabled wholesale under prefers-reduced-motion.

focus.rule: Global :focus-visible. No component may set outline-none; Tailwind's utilities layer beats the base layer and silently removes the ring.

browserSurfaces.rule: Every surface the browser would style by default is themed from the palette.

penRing.rule: A drawn stroke that closes past its own start. Never a border-radius: that reads as a wobbly rectangle at any size. Marks only reader-chosen entries.

constraints.note: At stamp scale the source covers are oversupplied with pixels rather than starved. This is why the world was chosen: the constraint that rules out editorial layouts is this format's advantage.

truthRules: Every listing is preceded by a heading naming the field that ordered it.
Table codes (A-01) are coordinates in the current listing, never identifiers and never ranks.
No client-side scoring, ranking or weighting. Recommendation logic lives in the backend.
Red marks what the catalogue did; blue marks what the reader did. Nothing is both.
Unbuilt routes are named in the back matter as inert text, never as a disabled control.
